nonPoolDecisions: Páipéar II (110) before 2012 is literature only: one whole question in prose and one in poetry, each from the prescribed course (Roinn A) or the optional course (Roinn B); each question is 55 = (a) 35 + (b) 20, both answered. Choice is not a route; no combination cards.

The scheme prints no answers: every ask restated with its price, and some prices split. Every award criterion is the restatement claimed at its printed price (or the totals its printed parts make), marked tariffOnly; each card says “The scheme prints no answer for this part.”

Language: one deduction per part as printed (0–5 under Prós Ainmnithe (a), Filíocht Ainmnithe (a) and Filíocht Roghnach (a); 0–3 under Prós Roghnach (a) and under every (b)); cards state it once on the question card and never inside a practice card.

Practice cards: every prescribed-course (a) sub-question at its own printed price (Prós Ainmnithe (i) 25 and (ii) 10 for each of three works; Gealt? and Bímse Buan (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9, (iv) 10). The optional-course sub-questions are open content and stay inside their question cards.
caveats: Páipéar II = 110: prose 55 (Roinn A Ceist 1 or Roinn B Ceist 1) and poetry 55 (Roinn A Ceist 2 or Roinn B Ceist 2); each (a) 35 + (b) 20.

Filíocht Roghnach (a), first option: the paper prints (iii) “(7 marc)” and (iv) “(10 marc)”; the scheme prices (iii) “= 4 marc” + “= 4 marc” = 8 and (iv) “= 1 marc}” + “= 4 marc × 2 = 8 marc}” = 9 (“= 9 marc”). Both make 17 and 35 in all. The criteria carry the scheme’s prices and the card carries a source note.

Prós Roghnach (a): the autobiography’s (i)+title total “= 25 mharc” is printed beside (ii)’s first line, and the play’s (i) price “= 23 marc” beside (ii)’s first line (PDF 8). Read where the paper prints them ((i) 23, (ii) 10): the play’s “= 23 marc” is carried as its own slice after the play’s (i) line, and the autobiography’s “= 25 mharc” is not carried.
Prós Roghnach (a) carries a 0–3 language deduction where the other three (a) questions carry 0–5; kept as printed.

Scheme misprints kept as printed: “Páid ó Sé” (paper “Páid Ó Sé”), “Fáth ar/nár thaitin ?”, “ghearrrscannáin”, “20marc”, “=14 marc”, “tré chéile” (paper “trína chéile”), “Conas atá fhios agat” (paper “a fhios”), “Cén fáth a raibh an file ag gol?” (paper “a bhfuil”), “an - neirbhíseach”. The paper prints “Faoiseamh a Gheobadsa” in (b)(ii) (its title and (b)(i): “Gheobhadsa”); kept as printed.
The scheme’s Gealt? (i)(a) reprint omits “thíos” and the Bímse Buan reprint likewise; the cards carry the paper’s question text.

Guidance slices are verbatim scheme text but leave out the work’s bracketed name before a price (“(Fiche Blian ag Fás)”, “(Clare sa Spéir)”, “(Lá Buí Bealtaine)”, “(Dírbheathaisnéis)”, “(Dán nua a chum bean)”, “(Dán nua le fear/bean)”, “(Dráma)”), the brace totals “= 10 marc” printed beside “Fáth ar/nár thaitin …” between the 6 and the 4 they total, and the braces; the card names the work and the criterion carries the total.
